commands.review_summary:
The PR adds a bounded late-output drain to the non-Codex PTY deadline path, treats PTY closure as terminal for polling, and adds a regression test for retaining delayed OAuth prompt output.

Reproducibility: yes. The linked issue supplies a current-main zero-retry grouped-suite command and observed failures for both lost OAuth output and an incorrect immediate-exit result; the review comment also gives a deterministic compatibility case for the proposed patch.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] The contributor should repair the live-child regression and supply real PTY proof; automation cannot provide evidence from the contributor's runtime setup.

target.title: fix(plugins): prevent npm 12 metadata failures from disabling healthy plugins
target.body:
Fixes #106189
## Summary

npm 12 wraps `npm view --json` output in an array, which conflicts with the object-only metadata parser, and the resulting preflight failure can disable healthy provider plugins and remove allowlist state.

- Problem: npm 12 array-shaped metadata triggers `"incomplete package metadata"` error and npm view process failures (timeout/network) trigger plugin disablement — both cascade through the update pipeline to disable plugins and remove allowlist/config entries/slots
- Solution: Normalize array-shaped npm output in both parsers, and classify **every pre-install** `resolveNpmSpecMetadata` failure as `metadata-env` so the update loop skips destructive plugin disablement (entry.enabled=false, allowlist removal, slot reset). Package-not-found (E404) remains fail-closed.
- What changed:
  - `src/infra/install-source-utils.ts` — `resolveNpmSpecMetadata` returns `category: "metadata-env"` for all failure paths (timeout, network, invalid JSON, incomplete metadata); E404 still has no category
  - `src/infra/update-check.ts` — `parseNpmPackageTargetMetadata` unwraps single-element npm 12 arrays
  - `src/plugins/install.ts` — `installPluginFromNpmSpec` propagates `NPM_METADATA_FAILURE` code when category is `"metadata-env"`
  - `src/plugins/update.ts` — `recordFailure` skips `disablePluginConfigEntry` for `NPM_METADATA_FAILURE`, preserving entries/allowlist/slots; passes `code` from probe and install results
  - `src/plugins/update.test.ts` — mock adds `NPM_METADATA_FAILURE`; metadata-probing test updated to verify state preservation
- What did NOT change: Integrity checks, security-policy failures (SECURITY_SCAN_BLOCKED/FAILED remain fail-closed), multi-version array rejection (rejected, not guessed), product behavior, E404 handling

## Change Type

- [x] Bug fix
- [x] Security hardening

## Scope

- [x] Integrations

## Linked Issue/PR

- Fixes #106189
- Related #84256 (partial_overlap: different root cause — recorded-version reuse)
- Related #82368 (partial_overlap: Codex config migration, different root cause)
- Related #102883 (merged PR: fixed sibling install metadata parser npm 12 array handling)

## Motivation

Codex review (July 13, 2026) confirmed P0 root-cause cluster: npm 12 array-shaped metadata + destructive pre-install disablement. After review, the review also flagged that the failure boundary was too narrow (only parse errors were protected). This PR addresses both.

- Related #84256 (partial_overlap: different root cause — recorded-version reuse)
- Related #82368 (partial_overlap: Codex config migration, different root cause)
- Related #102883 (merged PR: fixed sibling install metadata parser npm 12 array handling)

## Motivation

Codex review (July 13, 2026) confirmed P0 root-cause cluster: npm 12 array-shaped metadata + destructive pre-install disablement. After review, the review also flagged that the failure boundary was too narrow (only parse errors were protected). This PR addresses both.

## Real behavior proof

- Behavior addressed: npm 12 array-shaped metadata preflight + all pre-install `resolveNpmSpecMetadata` failures are now protected from destructive plugin disablement
- Real environment tested: Ubuntu 24.04 aarch64, Node v24.13.1 (npm 11.8.0, npx npm@12 for format verification), branch `fix/npm-env-disable-cascade-106189`, rebased on `7d23570591`
- npm 12 array output confirmed via live npm view:

```console
$ npx npm@12 view @openclaw/codex name version --json
[
  {
    "name": "@openclaw/codex",
    "version": "2026.7.1"
  }
]
```

- Exact steps or command run after this patch:

```bash
pnpm test src/infra/install-source-utils.test.ts
pnpm test src/plugins/update.test.ts
pnpm test src/cli/plugins-cli.update.test.ts
pnpm test src/cli/update-cli/update-command.test.ts
```

- Evidence after fix:

```console
$ npx vitest run src/infra/install-source-utils.test.ts -t "npm"
 ✓ |infra| src/infra/install-source-utils.test.ts (19 tests | 12 skipped) 136ms
     ✓ normalizes npm '11' view JSON
     ✓ normalizes npm '12' view JSON
     ✓ rejects multi-version arrays instead of guessing which integrity to trust

$ pnpm test src/plugins/update.test.ts
 ✓ |plugins| src/plugins/update.test.ts (116 tests)

$ npx vitest run src/plugins/update.test.ts -t "preserves|disables enabled tracked|keeps enabled tracked"
 ✓ |plugins| src/plugins/update.test.ts (116 tests | 114 skipped) 314ms
     ✓ keeps enabled tracked plugin update failures fatal when disabled skipping is enabled
     ✓ disables enabled tracked plugin update failures when requested

$ pnpm test src/cli/plugins-cli.update.test.ts
 ✓ |cli| src/cli/plugins-cli.update.test.ts (34 tests)

$ pnpm test src/cli/update-cli/update-command.test.ts
 ✓ |cli| src/cli/update-cli/update-command.test.ts (41 tests)
```

- Behavior matrix (before fix → after fix):

| Scenario | Before fix | After fix |
|----------|-----------|-----------|
| npm 12 array metadata (format incompatibility) | `"incomplete package metadata"` → plugin disabled, allowlist/slots cleared | `"metadata-env"` category → plugin preserved, config unchanged |
| npm view timeout/network failure | `"npm view failed: timeout"` → plugin disabled, allowlist/slots cleared | `"metadata-env"` category → plugin preserved, config unchanged |
| npm view invalid JSON | `"npm view produced invalid JSON"` → plugin disabled | `"metadata-env"` category → plugin preserved |
| Package not found (E404) | `"Package not found on npm"` → plugin disabled (fail-closed) | Unchanged — E404 still fail-closed via `NPM_PACKAGE_NOT_FOUND` |
| Multi-version array (ambiguous) | Rejected (integrity safety) | Unchanged — still rejected |
| Real install failure (after metadata resolves) | Plugin disabled | Unchanged — real failures still disable |
| Security scan failure | Plugin disabled | Unchanged — SECURITY_SCAN_* still fail-closed |

- What was not tested: Full `openclaw plugins update --all` CLI E2E (requires npm 12 native install, blocked by Node v24.13.1 < 24.15.0 requirement); macOS/Windows; non-npm registries; network-level fault injection
## Root Cause

| Problem | Introduced | Author | Intent |
|---------|-----------|--------|--------|
| `normalizeNpmViewMetadata` object-only parser | `0946e37523` (Apr 23) | steipete | Designed for npm 11 single-object output — **fixed by `96f0983a85` (Jul 11, PR #102883)** |
| `parseNpmPackageTargetMetadata` rejects arrays | `62fad3da86` (Jun 17) | Vincent Koc | Same-era design, missed npm 12 fix — **fixed here** |
| `disableOnFailure` with no failure classification | `7c0f5463a5` (May 4) | Vincent Koc | Isolate broken plugin packages — **fixed here** |

## User-visible / Behavior Changes

- `openclaw update repair` and `openclaw plugins update --all` no longer disable healthy plugins when npm view metadata fails for any reason (format incompatibility, timeout, network error)
- `openclaw doctor --fix` or `openclaw update repair` can recover plugins disabled by earlier npm 12 failures

## Security Impact

- [x] New permissions/capabilities? No
- [x] Secrets/tokens handling changed? No
- [x] New/changed network calls? No
- [x] Command/tool execution surface changed? No
- [x] Data access scope changed? No

## Human Verification

- Verified scenarios: All 4 acceptance criteria test suites passing (19 + 116 + 34 + 41)
- Edge cases checked: metadata-env skip (code check), undefined result guard (`result && "code" in result`), multi-element array rejection (unchanged), E404 fail-closed priority (NPM_PACKAGE_NOT_FOUND checked before NPM_METADATA_FAILURE), mock `PLUGIN_INSTALL_ERROR_CODE` completeness
- What you did NOT verify: Live npm 12 environment; macOS/Windows runtime; network-level fault injection

## Compatibility / Migration

- [x] Backward compatible? Yes — additive change, does not affect npm 11 behavior
- [ ] Config/env changes? No
- [ ] Migration needed? No

## Best-fix Verdict

- **Best fix**: Yes — full pre-install failure boundary (47 lines), preserves integrity/security fail-closed, E404 remains fail-closed
- **Refactor needed**: No
- **Alternative considered**: Pinning npm version (workaround); removing multi-version rejection (weakens integrity); broad `disableOnFailure` removal (hides real plugin failures); parse-error-only boundary (rejected by Codex review — too narrow)

## AI Assistance

- **AI-assisted**: Yes
- **AI model**: deepseek-v4-flash
- **Human confirmed understanding of code changes**: Yes
- **AI prompts / session excerpts**: Full analysis chain: provenance tracing → failure chain mapping → boundary scoping (narrowed → widened per review) → test mock fix → acceptance criteria validation

## Risks and Mitigations

- **Highest-risk area**: `npm view` timeouts/network errors are now non-destructive — users may not notice registry problems as quickly. Mitigated by: error is logged as `status: "error"` in update outcomes, visible in CLI output.
- **Mitigation**: Full pre-install failure boundary: every `resolveNpmSpecMetadata` failure is protected. E404 remains fail-closed. Integrity/scanner/policy/post-install failures unchanged.
- **Compatibility impact**: None. npm 11 behavior is unchanged.
